{{Quote|Come on, baby! Move those lekku! Show Veeboo what you got! I'm paying good money for this!|[[Veeboo Lunx]], to Ann'ya|<ref name="TOR:CV" />}}
'''Ann'ya''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked as a dancer at [[Varath cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] employed as a dancer, Ann'ya performed for the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Veeboo Lunx]] at some point in [[3643 BBY]]. While dancing for the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], Lunx's [[Hunter (individual)|rival]] arrived at the cantina. Events quickly escalated, and Veebo was killed. Ann'ya pleaded with the bounty hunter to let her live, and she managed to run off.<ref name="TOR:CV" />
